response.text: {"verdict": "covered", "clause_ids": ["A4.1"], "rationale": "The claim involves medical treatment (fracture of the distal radius) resulting from an accident during a ski trip. Clause A4.1 covers medical expenses abroad due to an acute illness or injury during travel. There is no indication of pre-existing conditions, planned treatment, or intentional injury, and the policy explicitly includes extreme sports (as stated in the product description). Therefore, the claim is covered under A4.1."}
